# [Audio Briefing (CarPlay)](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/audio-briefing-carplay/13849)


[idea](https://forum.newsblur.com/c/idea/5)


[anon-37641789236](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/anon-37641789236)


September 23, 2026, 1:44pm 1


We have briefings, we have Ask AI, and we have an embedded audio player for podcasts. How about combining them to get full or summarized audio at the global (all feeds) or article (specific feed item with extracted full text) level, to listen to in the car or public transit?


I suppose with local models, the voice-enablement should not pose any additional burden on NewsBlur’s the servers.
